app.name: prism-kappa
app.title: Prism Kappa
app.purpose: Decides whether one object may enter the Prism under its kappa label, the content address of UOR-Foundation/kappa-registry (feat/rewrite-after-poc, commit 618f477745e601f1bf1bd5cc62aed6fea4c8936d): an axis name, a colon and the digest in lowercase hex. A label is read as kappa-registry's Kappa::parse reads it, and an object is admitted only when the browser re-derived the very digest the label names.

fields.name: colon
fields.means: whether the label has the colon that separates its axis from its digest

fields.name: axis
fields.means: the axis the label names before its colon, one of kappa-registry's six, or anything else

fields.name: digits
fields.means: whether the digest has exactly twice its axis's digest length in hex digits

fields.name: hex
fields.means: whether every digest digit is lowercase hex (0-9, a-f)

fields.name: digest
fields.means: the one word the request carries: the browser re-derived the label's digest from the object's bytes (match), derived another (mismatch), could not derive it on this host (uncomputed), or found a SHA-1 collision

meanings.admit: the object enters under its label
meanings.unverified: the label is well formed, its digest not derived here
meanings.mismatch: the object's bytes derive another digest
meanings.collision: the digest is a known SHA-1 collision
meanings.nocolon: the label has no axis separator
meanings.unknownaxis: the axis is not one of kappa-registry's six
meanings.digits: the digest has the wrong length for its axis
meanings.badhex: the digest is not lowercase hex

rules.says: when colon is absent then nocolon
rules.why: Prism Kappa: the decision tree's path to nocolon

rules.says: when axis is other then unknownaxis
rules.why: Prism Kappa: the decision tree's path to unknownaxis

rules.says: when digits is wrong then digits
rules.why: Prism Kappa: the decision tree's path to digits

rules.says: when hex is bad then badhex
rules.why: Prism Kappa: the decision tree's path to badhex

rules.says: when digest is collision then collision
rules.why: Prism Kappa: the decision tree's path to collision

rules.says: when digest is mismatch then mismatch
rules.why: Prism Kappa: the decision tree's path to mismatch

rules.says: when digest is uncomputed then unverified
rules.why: Prism Kappa: the decision tree's path to unverified

app.otherwiseWhy: Prism Kappa: the decision tree's path that meets no test

properties.says: always when colon is absent then nocolon
properties.why: a label without its colon names no axis (KappaParseError::NoColon)

properties.says: always when colon is present and axis is other then unknownaxis
properties.why: only kappa-registry's six axes are content addresses (KappaParseError::UnknownAxis)

properties.says: never when digits is wrong then admit
properties.why: a digest of the wrong length for its axis is no address on it (KappaParseError::WrongDigitCount)

properties.says: never when digits is wrong then unverified
properties.why: a digest of the wrong length for its axis is no address on it (KappaParseError::WrongDigitCount)

properties.says: never when hex is bad then admit
properties.why: the wire form is lowercase hex only; any other digit refuses (KappaParseError::BadHex)

properties.says: never when hex is bad then unverified
properties.why: the wire form is lowercase hex only; any other digit refuses (KappaParseError::BadHex)

properties.says: never when digest is mismatch then admit
properties.why: bytes that do not re-derive to their label never enter under it (KappaParseError::DigestMismatch)

properties.says: never when digest is mismatch then unverified
properties.why: bytes that do not re-derive to their label never enter under it (KappaParseError::DigestMismatch)

properties.says: never when digest is collision then admit
properties.why: content that collides on SHA-1 is refused (KappaParseError::CollisionDetected)

properties.says: never when digest is collision then unverified
properties.why: content that collides on SHA-1 is refused (KappaParseError::CollisionDetected)

properties.says: never when digest is uncomputed then admit
properties.why: a digest the browser could not re-derive is never taken as verified

properties.says: never when colon is present and digits is right and hex is lower and digest is match then nocolon
properties.why: a well-formed label whose digest the browser re-derived is refused only for naming an unknown axis

properties.says: never when colon is present and digits is right and hex is lower and digest is match then digits
properties.why: a well-formed label whose digest the browser re-derived is refused only for naming an unknown axis

properties.says: never when colon is present and digits is right and hex is lower and digest is match then badhex
properties.why: a well-formed label whose digest the browser re-derived is refused only for naming an unknown axis

properties.says: never when colon is present and digits is right and hex is lower and digest is match then mismatch
properties.why: a well-formed label whose digest the browser re-derived is refused only for naming an unknown axis

properties.says: never when colon is present and digits is right and hex is lower and digest is match then collision
properties.why: a well-formed label whose digest the browser re-derived is refused only for naming an unknown axis

properties.says: never when colon is present and digits is right and hex is lower and digest is match then unverified
properties.why: a well-formed label whose digest the browser re-derived is refused only for naming an unknown axis
